releases.name: 2026.09.8 - Share, Watch, and Stay in Control
2026.09.7 - Smarter Sync, Wider Alerts
notes: TubeArchivist watch status now syncs both ways, including changes back to unwatched, while video cards show when a video is already available in your archive.
Notifications now support followed channels, automatic tag rules, and per-source overrides.
Forward notifications externally through Apprise, webhooks, or ntfy, with per-profile delivery targets and a built-in test notification.
Includes small polish and stability improvements throughout the app.

releases.name: 2026.09.5 - Control Your Queue, Scale Your Library
notes: PostgreSQL deployments can now scale with coordinated HTTP replicas and a single background worker, plus a new Cluster settings dashboard.
Downloads are easier to manage: pin completed files, browse them by playlist, and automatically download or protect followed playlists.
Video-card scheduling controls can now be hidden from settings.
Polished the feed with corrected avatar layout and smaller interface fixes.

releases.name: 2026.09.3 - Downloads That Stay, Deployments That Scale
notes: Pin downloads to keep them safe from automatic cleanup, or enable playlist-based offline availability with optional cleanup protection. The Downloads library now includes search, a kept-items filter, and playlist grouping.
Run YT Zero on clustered PostgreSQL deployments with coordinated HTTP replicas and a single background worker, including cluster health and status visibility.
Customize video cards further: hide the scheduling row and add an action to switch directly between video and audio playback modes.
Corrected French translations across the server and interface.
Includes small internal fixes and polish for a smoother overall experience.

releases.name: 2026.09.2 - Native Installs, Ready to Go
notes: Native Linux and Proxmox installations now have the complete release archive they need to install and update successfully.
GitHub releases now include a versioned native package with the built web client, application source, lockfile, version metadata, and a SHA-256 checksum for verification.

releases.name: 2026.09.1 - Watch Your Way
notes: Build a temporary play queue for the current browser tab, then save it as a personal playlist whenever you like.
Choose which channels and playlists can notify you, independently of your general notification settings.
Set custom playback-speed options up to 4×.
Manage household access with profile groups and a detailed permission matrix.

Use YT Zero in French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, or Hungarian—alongside English, Polish, and German. The interface and playlist titles now consistently follow your profile language.
Keep incognito viewing out of related-video recommendations for stronger privacy.
Stream subtitles on demand without creating files on disk, while keeping downloaded and TubeArchivist subtitles available offline.
Improve direct playback for cookie-authenticated yt-dlp streams and reduce memory use with TubeArchivist.

releases.name: 2026.08.36 - Queue It, Watch It Your Way
notes: Build a session play queue from video cards and suggestions, play items in order, and save the queue as a personal playlist whenever you want to keep it.
Stream available subtitles on demand in the local and direct players—without downloading video files or writing subtitle sidecars to disk. Existing downloaded subtitles remain available offline.
Choose the interface language per profile: French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Japanese join English, Polish, and German.
Enjoy a set of small visual and interaction refinements, including an improved play-queue menu and watch-page controls.

releases.name: 2026.08.35 - YT Zero
notes: Start downloads, scheduling, or playlist additions directly from YouTube search results.
Choose video or audio when starting or continuing a playlist. Audio mode now uses completed local downloads, continues across playlist tracks, and has improved iOS lock-screen playback and buffering.
Added **Direct stream** as a remote-player option: play a compatible video through YT Zero without creating a download. It can also take over when the YouTube embed is unavailable.
Local-player subtitles now show only tracks actually available for the video, with sensible language fallbacks.
Added video bookmarks with timestamps and notes.
New videos that need importing now show a loading state before the selected player is ready.
YouTube pages and search metadata now follow the app language, including improved localized count and date parsing.
Reduced unnecessary YouTube traffic with backoff for Shorts classification and temporary address-level refusals.
General performance and build-loading improvements.
